about: What a class does NOT show for an attack: a person's note, appended by tools/admission/manifest.py to the 'why' column of evidence/MANIFEST.md. It never changes a class. Written 2026-11-12 after a merge review.

limits.ai-02-triple-race-cap-breach: validates the double pay (M5, guard:vulnerable_fixture), not the cap breach its title names: on M5 the cap, reserved at each check, refuses the third pay, so 200 is paid twice and the cap holds
limits.ai-03-mixed-invoice-race-cap: matched only on guard:vulnerable_fixture, which has no daily cap; the cap part of its title is not tested (on M5 the cap refuses the 4th pay, measured in the 2026-11-13 survey)
limits.ai-04-cap-fill-then-big: catches only M2 (no daily-cap check) through one invoice over the cap on its own; the 'fill the cap first' part (a running total, M3) is not tested
limits.ai-08-lowgas-retry-double: validates only the already-paid check (M4): the 50 TGas pay succeeds, so no half-paid state is reached; the low-gas part of the title is not tested (M11 measured it: nothing breaks)
limits.n00c44f69-1-split-payments-cap-bypass-ra: validates race-m3 (the day's spend counted in the callback, not at the check) through proven overlap; race-m3 holds when the same pays are sent one after the other (survey 2026-11-13). M3 (cap checked per payment) breaks it either way and is not the matched flaw. race-m3 is a planted fixture from the race study, not a bug found in a researched guard
